definitions.explanation: A humble way to refer to one's own younger brother. An older, formal expression.
A subordinate or junior member in a hierarchical organization, especially in yakuza or gang contexts. Refers to someone who serves under a senior figure.

examples.japanese: {舎弟|しゃてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
{舎弟|しゃてい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My younger brother graduated from university this year.

examples.japanese: {舎弟|しゃてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついてまいります。
examples.english: My younger brother will accompany us.

examples.japanese: {舎弟|しゃてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{連|つ}れる→引き連れる：15445_hikitsureru⟧。
{舎弟|しゃてい}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{兄貴|あにき}→兄貴：11623_aniki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧。
examples.english: The underlings follow the boss's orders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{組長|くみちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{舎弟|しゃてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{印象的|いんしょうてき}→印象的：15547_inshouteki⟧だった。
examples.english: The scene in the movie where the boss's underling betrays him was memorable.

notes: Sense 1 is the original meaning: {舎|しゃ} is a humble prefix (as in {舎兄|しゃけい} for older brother) and {弟|てい} means younger brother. This usage is quite formal and archaic. Sense 2 is the more commonly encountered modern usage, strongly associated with yakuza films and fiction. In this context, ⟦{兄貴|あにき}→兄貴：11623_aniki⟧ (big brother/boss) and {舎弟|しゃてい} (follower/junior) form a hierarchical pair. Related: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧ (younger brother — standard), ⟦{兄貴|あにき}→兄貴：11623_aniki⟧ (big brother/boss), ⟦{子分|こぶん}→子分：19895_kobun⟧ (follower, henchman).
